prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production RGBA atlas for a detailed hand-cut paper pop-up battle diorama, 1536x1024.
Twelve separate cutouts in an exact FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW grid, generous 24-pixel transparent gutters, each entirely in its cell. No text or grid lines.
Theme: a quiet ancient limestone cave in Pokémon Emerald, pale chalk and muted sage moss, deep desaturated teal interior, small turquoise seep pools. This is a papercraft theatre kit, NOT a complete landscape.
Style: flat illustrated paper silhouettes composed of visibly overlapping thin paper laminations, crisp cream cut edges, hand drawn fine cracks, moss as separately pasted olive paper leaf flecks. Elegant rich miniature craftsmanship but flat forms and restrained shadows, no photorealism, no chunky low-poly stone, no 3D render. Front elevation with only tiny top surfaces. Avoid broad solid rectangular backdrops. Every cutout has a beautiful irregular contour.
Row 1 left to right:
1. Left half of a tall uneven limestone cave rim, open on its right, layered chalk ribbons with sparse hanging moss, dark blue-grey crevices. Asymmetric, NO complete arch.
2. Right half of a different tall uneven limestone cave rim, open on its left, a few stepped shelves and delicate ferns; NO complete arch.
3. Slender irregular darker teal-grey rock ridge: six individual narrow overlapping paper spires, height varied, low connecting base, no background.
4. Five hanging cream stalactites spaced separately, NO connecting top bar, little thin moss tips. Each a narrow flat paper triangle with two overlapping facets.
Row 2 left to right:
5. Small rear cave depth silhouette, irregular dark teal scalloped mineral edges layered inside one another, no stone arch, no stairs, flat paper.
6. A pale low stone ledge with a flat dry top and two overlapping torn paper fascia strips, a little moss. No water.
7. Narrow vertical turquoise seep ribbon, three slightly irregular light blue paper strips with tiny pale glints, scalloped foam at foot. No rocks.
8. Low elongated oval turquoise pool of overlapping pale ripple ribbons with filled turquoise center, no rock border.
Row 3 left to right:
9. Detailed small fern fan with seven slender sage/olive fronds, each made of cut paper leaflets, tiny moss base, no rocks.
10. Three modest pale limestone outcrops as one compact asymmetric cluster of layered flat paper facets, hairline cracks, some moss.
11. Separate small scatter of limestone chips, tiny ivory shell fossils, pale moss flecks, no ground.
12. Three isolated pale turquoise paper teardrops, vertically arranged with generous separation for separate cropping, no trails.
No characters, Pokémon, ball, lettering, emblems, labels, UI, watermarks, floor plane, cast ground shadows or background haze. Actual transparent empty background.
